speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your fatigue and pallor, can you describe when these symptoms started and if you have noticed any unusual bleeding, bruising, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 67-year-old male. The patient complains of a 2-month history of generalized fatigue. He mentions no specific triggers but notes that the fatigue has been progressively worsening. He denies any recent infections, significant weight loss, or night sweats.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any shortness of breath, palpitations, or chest pain, and have you noticed any dark or tarry stools that might indicate gastrointestinal bleeding? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the marked leukocytosis, anemia, and thrombocytopenia, I suspect a hematologic malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Presence of immature cells with large, prominent nucleoli and pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of Auer rods is diagnostic for Acute Myeloid Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
